quality_contribution: preservation and diagnosis of reused development results

replay.numeric_equality: exact; no tolerance or dtype conversion of saved NPZ inputs/scores

test_policy: No real test inputs or scores. Reporting metadata is filtered to original primary train before joins. Existing development assessment only.
limits: Frozen thresholds; no winner/profile reselection. Reused folds, repeated seeds and identical HGB scores are not independent evidence. New hypotheses need separate bounded protocols.
